sloka: ततो रामः शुभां वाणीं देवदेवस्य भाषिताम् ।श्रुत्वा परमतेजस्वी वाल्मीकिमिदमब्रवीत् ।। ७.९८.२५ ॥
transliteration: tato rāmaḥ śubhāṁ vāṇīṁ devadevasya bhāṣitām ।śrutvā paramatejasvī vālmīkimidamabravīt ।। 7.98.25 ॥

translations.english: Then, the most effulgent Rama, having heard the auspicious words spoken by Brahma, the god of gods, said this to Valmiki.
